title: Mitigating Gender Bias via Fostering Exploratory Thinking in LLMs
findings: The paper's method for mitigating gender bias, which fosters exploratory thinking, also improved model accuracy in the 'Religion' category of the BBQ social bias benchmark. For the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model, accuracy on religion-related questions increased from 80.33% to 82.00% after fine-tuning. For the Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 model, accuracy increased from 63.08% to 69.08%.
